findings.reason: naming the existing regen path and `llm_cost_*`/`cost_model` instrumentation replaces "measure from scratch" with "read the owners", which changes the node's brief from building a census to querying existing machinery.
findings.text: the plan's deliverable is a measurement phase (f-srd-001, "measure the regenerable and protected populations, the measured cost per identity, what a regenerate clears, and what it would reintroduce") but it never names the machinery that already performs regeneration — `sn run --force` (sn.py:1447), `--from-model` (sn.py:1560), `--min-score` regen mode (sn.py:1641, gate at sn.py:3133) — nor the cost/audit owners (`imas_codex/standard_names/cost_model.py`, `audits.py`); a plan whose one action is to measure five quantities must say which existing instruments measure them

findings.reason: if `origin` is being retired and the backfill that would make it trustworthy has already been refused twice, the plan must state which field replaces it as the regenerable/protected discriminator before it can be released.
findings.text: the plan is keyed throughout on the `origin` axis (§1 lines 37-43 "1,099 identities with no `origin`"; §3 lines 84-89 "origin=pipeline after backfill" and "origin=catalog_edit ... 2,096 and 2,031"; the scope options at decisions lines 111-114 all branch on it; meta depends-on `sn-origin-provenance-backfill`): but `sn-lifecycle-integrity` records a lead ruling (2026-09-04, `origin-axis-disposition = retire-origin-entirely`) to drop the field, and the plan's own declared prerequisite `sn-origin-provenance-backfill` records TWO refusals on positive control (generation-evidence rule misclassified 1372 of 1798 controls; ledger-derived origin failed 1693 of 1798 controls)

findings.reason: naming `filter_protected` as the owner of the protected-population read turns the plan's measurement into a call to the existing guard instead of a parallel census.
findings.text: §3's "Protected population — origin=catalog_edit and the accepted documentation they carry ... which a regenerate must exclude rather than rebuild" is the exact responsibility of `filter_protected()` in `imas_codex/standard_names/protection.py:5` (the single guard every protected-field writer calls), and §2's table "Dual-bound source with a single-producer loser ... Regeneration re-derives the same two candidate spellings" is the composer's job owned by `imas_codex/standard_names/workers.py`; the plan should extend these owners rather than re-derive their outputs

findings.reason: citing the existing estimator and cost fields tells the author the "measured cost per identity" figure is already collected and only needs reading, which is a smaller and cheaper node than measuring it afresh.
findings.text: §3's "Cost per identity — measured, not estimated: compose is free on the local seat and review is the paid axis, so the figure is dominated by quorum draws" duplicates the pipeline-aware cost estimator already in `imas_codex/standard_names/cost_model.py:1` and the per-name graph instrumentation (`llm_cost_generate_name`, `llm_cost_refine_name`, `llm_cost_refine_docs`, `StandardName.regen_count`, `SNRun.names_regenerated`, schema lines 1834-1915)

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the plan adds no module and no code surface; it emits a written threshold and one scope decision, so there is no interface behind which behaviour could be hidden or shallowly spread.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan's "protected population" and "cost per identity" reproduce quantities whose owners already exist (`filter_protected()` and the cost estimator) rather than extending them.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; the plan's only deliverables are a written threshold and a scope decision, adding nothing to any counted family, so there is no surface to retire or merge.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan proposes a fresh measurement phase (followup f-srd-001) without citing the regeneration path (`sn run --force/--from-model/--min-score`), the cost instrumentation (`imas_codex/standard_names/cost_model.py`, `llm_cost_*`), or the audit machinery (`imas_codex/standard_names/audits.py`) that already produce the five quantities; and it keys its whole premise on `origin`, whose fate a sibling plan has already decided.
